issues.description: Fields numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents: the UML in problem_statement.md declares these two attributes as type double, whereas the solution implementation declares them as int and the UML also declares getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int. Specifically, problem_statement.md lists '-numberOfInscribedStudents: double' and '-numberOfGuestStudents: double' but solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares 'private int numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'private int numberOfGuestStudents'. This mismatch between the attribute types in the UML and the int return type used by getTotalNumberOfStudents (and the solution) can confuse students about which data type to use and lead to inconsistent implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent across all artifacts. Prefer updating the UML in problem_statement.md to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int (to match getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and the solution). Update any textual descriptions that mention double accordingly. Alternatively, if floating-point counts are intended, change the solution fields and related methods to use double consistently. Also update the template TODO/comments to indicate the chosen type so students implement the matching types.
